mutations.name: a green left branch is implemented again
kills: a fresh build-surface start over a branch a stopped run left behind picks up a branch a stopped run left green at its head: no implement turn and no gate rerun, straight to review

mutations.name: a left branch's gates are rerun in round 0
kills: a fresh build-surface start over a branch a stopped run left behind picks up a branch a stopped run left green at its head: no implement turn and no gate rerun, straight to review

mutations.name: a left branch with a failing gate counts as green
kills: a fresh build-surface start over a branch a stopped run left behind implements again when the left branch has a failing gate at its head

mutations.name: a passing gate record with failure: null is rejected
kills: a fresh build-surface start over a branch a stopped run left behind picks up a branch whose passing gate record carries failure: null

mutations.name: a slice whose head is in the base is built again
kills: a fresh build-surface start over a slice an earlier run already merged skips a slice whose head is in the base and builds the slice that depends on it

mutations.name: a squash-merged slice is built again
kills: a fresh build-surface start over a slice an earlier run already merged skips a squash-merged slice whose PR reports merged, though its head is not in the base
